foundations.statement: All named D7/FamP/GoodR/adm2/Conclusion41/Facts/period and coefficient structures retain their source fields. Cheb and the precise integral Bhatt-Scholze predicate are retained exactly where the source theorem assumes them.

Finite-dimensional composition series, semisimple finite algebras and their splitting over an algebraic closure in characteristic zero; PID finite torsion-free modules and splitting of free quotients. The problem-specific character descent and saturated-lattice continuity argument are proved in DFD1-DFD2.

Galois decomposition-group cardinality ef, finite factorization of a nonzero ideal, and finiteness of the integers in a finite extension of Q_l. No additional automorphy or comparison theorem is asserted.
Finite-dimensional module topologies, exponential power series and elementary inequalities. All new uniform cutoffs and original scale comparisons are proved here.
